pastyears.note: These are the totals official sources reported for the same calendar week or month. They are not adjusted: a year in which more countries reported, or tested more, shows a higher total for that reason alone. The comparison describes past reports and says nothing about what will happen.

kit.lead: Everything official sources have published about this event in one page: {n, plural, one {# notice} other {# notices}} between {first} and {last}.
kit.check: Figures marked “read automatically” were read from the notice text by a program. Open the notice and check the figure before you publish it.
kit.timeline: {n, plural, one {The notice} other {All # notices, newest first}}
kit.limits: What this page cannot tell you
kit.limit1: How many people are actually affected: official notices count reported cases, which miss people who were never tested or reported.
kit.limit2: Whether the event is over: “no recent update” only means no new notice was published.
kit.limit3: How serious the event is, or what will happen next: this site makes no assessment and no forecast.
kit.limit4: Anything the sources have not published. For that, ask the health authority named in the notices.

ccounts.note: A figure appears here only when one sentence of a notice states it as a total and names that country alone. Figures given in tables or for several countries together are not read; they are on the notice itself.
